answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to build meaningful connections within the music industry and participate in helping one of my favorite artists on their music journey, whether that be with campaigns, touring, or getting their name out there - it would be amazing to contribute to that process.
answers.drew: The magic that goes behind an artists' journey to success and the connection between their audiences worldwide. I would love to take part of that process and help build/strengthen that connection.
answers.seeking: People who are just as creative and passionate about music are who I am looking to connect with. It would be awesome to hear from other peoples' stories and journey navigating through the music/entertainment industry and learn from their experiences Would love to be part of this intern party!
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is my mom. She always inspires me to do and be better - personally and professionally.
